experienceContract.primaryUser: Timekeeper monitoring closure and Time controller executing governed close or reopen
experienceContract.operationalQuestion: Which time periods are safe to close, which blockers or corrections remain, and what immutable result is ready for Payroll?
experienceContract.primaryAction: Validate a period, approve close or reopen with justification, then inspect handoff state and receipt.

commandsAndReceipt.authClassification: ACTION.HRIS_TIME_CLOSE:EXECUTE per source register; do not silently remodel

sodRules: correction maker must differ from close approver

requiredSchema: immutable closed results, lines and source revisions

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Validation captures an immutable blocker snapshot and expected version without closing or partially mutating the period.
Close requires CLOSED-eligible state, current CAS, elevated step-up, approval and all SoD rules.
A successful close creates one immutable result with source, rule and payload digests plus count and sequence evidence.
Reopen requires elevated step-up, reason, current version and an approver distinct from the original closer.
Reopen is a forward correction that never mutates or deletes the closed result or prior events.
Payroll handoff can start only from CLOSED and binds the immutable result id, close revision and digest.
ACKNOWLEDGED, REJECTED and RESULT_UNKNOWN outcomes retain stable receipt and refetch lineage; exact replay is idempotent.
SVC-PEP-TIM-001 rejects browser tokens, wrong workload, wrong audience, unsigned or mismatched tenant and stale owner grant.
Streaming refetch verifies source, rule and payload digest, row count and sequence before Payroll may accept the result.
Wrong tenant, legal entity, time group, purpose, field decision, revision, capability or step-up fails closed and leaks no period existence.
All three entry queries satisfy empty, unavailable, partial, complete, cursor, stable-order, field-decision, locale/time-zone, deep-link/action allowlist and Problem invariants.
Command controls preserve period, filters, selection and justification across refresh, partial failure and receipt recovery.
1440, 1280, 390, 320 and 200-percent zoom plus light, dark, high contrast, reduced motion and keyboard navigation pass.
Feature OFF or unenrolled tenant mounts no close runtime; changed-path evidence proves existing time features and generated XCON contracts were not modified or recounted.
